products.name: Heritage Wood Churned Mara Chekku Groundnut Oil
products.description: Unrefined, unbleached, cholesterol-free native peanut cooking oil churned in heirloom Vaagai timber mortars. Retains rich nutty aroma and natural antioxidants.

products.name: Tanjore Royal Ponni Raw Rice
products.description: Aged 12 months. Single-origin unpolished raw rice from Cauvery delta basin. Fluffy, non-sticky texture perfect for daily meals.

products.name: A2 Desi Cow Bilona Ghee
products.description: Cultured curd churned using traditional wooden bilona method from grass-fed Kangayam desi cows. Granular texture with golden aroma.

products.name: Organic Ooty Hill Carrots
products.description: Crisp, naturally sweet hill-grown carrots harvested in Ooty. Washed and packed on morning harvest.

products.name: Unpolished Native Toor Dal
products.description: Zero chemical polish, naturally sun-dried toor dal. Rich in wholesome protein with authentic sambar aroma.

products.name: Pure Cold Pressed Gingelly Sesame Oil
products.description: Black sesame seeds crushed with palm jaggery in traditional Vaagai wood churn. Deep aroma and authentic taste for kuzhambu and idli podi.

products.name: Pure Naatu Sakkarai Country Sugar
products.description: Unrefined sugarcane jaggery powder made without sodium hydrosulphite or chemical clarifiers. Pure caramel sweetness.

products.name: Erode High Curcumin Turmeric Powder
products.description: Single-estate Erode turmeric with over 5.2% natural curcumin. Ground using slow stone pulverizers to preserve volatile aromatic oils.

products.name: Free Range Country Chicken Eggs (Pack of 6)
products.description: Farm-laid native country chicken eggs from free roaming birds. Natural yellow-orange yolks rich in natural lutein.

products.name: Handmade Butter Kai Murukku
products.description: Crispy traditional hand-twisted Kai Murukku made with unpolished raw rice flour, fresh butter, and ajwain fried in pure groundnut oil.

products.name: Kumbakonam Degree Filter Coffee Powder
products.description: 85% Plantation A Arabica & Robusta coffee with 15% Jamnagar chicory blend. Deep decoction with velvety South Indian froth.

products.name: Pollachi Sweet Tender Coconut (Elaneer)
products.description: Naturally chilled, sweet Pollachi red tender coconut with abundant electrolyte water and soft malai.
